questions.question: List the names of Passive portfolios, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status='Passive' ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: Which portfolios have Active status? Return only portfolio names alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status='Active' ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: List the portfolio names with the Index strategy, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE strategy_type='Index' ORDER BY portfolio_name
